### 📌 Summary – Top 3‑5 Decisions  

| # | Decision | Rationale |
|---|----------|-----------|
| **D1** | **Lock the acoustic core to SI units and add automated unit‑conversion tests** | The audit showed scattered `mm`, `cm`, `in` usage that leads to pitch errors > 5 ¢. A single source‑of‑truth eliminates the most common correctness bug. |
| **D2** | **Introduce a thin‑layer CAD abstraction (OCCT → `cad_backend.py`) and make export plug‑in‑based** | Currently STL/STEP generation is tangled with GUI code, blocking parallel work on the laptop and hindering future Fusion 360/Blender plugins. |
| **D3** | **Enable deterministic CI builds on both desktop & laptop via a shared Tailscale‑triggered workflow** | The review noted “flaky local runs”. A CI that pulls the same Docker image and runs the test suite on each machine guarantees reproducibility. |
| **D4** | **Add a physical‑validation harness (intonation test‑suite + reference clarinet)** | Before trusting any design we need a measurable benchmark; the audit flagged missing end‑to‑end verification. |
| **D5** | **Refactor configuration into a single, version‑controlled JSON schema with migration scripts** | Config drift between machines was a frequent source of bugs; a schema + migration removes that class of errors. |
